root_cause_analysis: Meta Graph API application request limit reached and activity restricted (Code 4, Subcode 2207051) due to automated posting rate limits or action block enforcement.
actionable_instructions: Check the Meta Developer Portal / Meta Business Manager for active enforcement warnings or API quota usage.
Pause automated posting for at least 1 to 24 hours to allow the Instagram action block to clear naturally.
If the issue persists, submit a review request via Meta Business Support for error subcode 2207051.
